restart.title: Restart sing-box?
restart.description: Current connections of all devices will drop: downloads and calls will break. sing-box comes back in a few seconds.

stop.title: Stop sing-box?
stop.description: Routing will stop: devices on the network lose internet access until sing-box is started again.
